frequency_basis: Source/PLL/build nominal clock; not independently measured physical frequency
input_description: User-connected HDMI IN/display rig; intended existing PC native1080p29.97/30. Current scene/physical PCLK not independently recaptured; valid native PGSIG and input-admission source contract bound the measured pipeline. Not new-camera calibration or image-quality evidence.

counter_semantics.captured_frames: Complete source DMA descriptors accepted by bank source_pop; not all sensor/HDMI arrivals
counter_semantics.processed_frames: Successful processing completions; sampled IDs and atomic completion tuple must agree
counter_semantics.presented_frames: New greater frame IDs finishing successful reader/pixel/FIFO display lease; not physical photons
counter_semantics.scan_repeat_frames: Successful nonblank display lease completing the same last presented ID
counter_semantics.dropped_frames: Rejected completion of a previously granted capture; no-grant input windows and separate no_free are omitted

sampled_internal_sourceaccept_to_success.scope: Only requested last-completion samples, not a complete per-frame latency distribution; canonical plan supplies at most2 samples

limitations: Last-cycle samples are not a complete per-frame latency distribution.
PGSTAT02 dropped_frames is DMA rejected completion; unadmitted no-grant frames are not exported.
This is internal processing/new-presentation timing, not exposure/input-pixel-to-monitor E2E.
A fixed-mode build identity is required; matching first/last mode alone cannot prove a mixed AB window is pure.
Calibration identity is provenance, not proof that K/D belongs to the new camera.
Counter deltas are modulo32 under an externally attested uninterrupted epoch; core ticks are full64-bit and their difference gets no+1.
Only legacy per-frame last-index gets+1. Absolute duration is excluded if absence of its32-bit wrap is unproven.
Low32 core-tick carry is supported; a decreasing full64 tick or repeated/out-of-order stats sequence is rejected.
Event counters support one modulo32 crossing under the bounded window; source frame-ID descent/wrap is rejected because this display profile uses an unsigned new-ID comparison.
The first endpoint latency may belong to a completion before the throughput window; only new in-window samples enter the coverage numerator.
Native duration lower bound is applied only to no-wrap-proved samples; low legacy residues without that proof stay unproven.
Repeat fraction excludes blank/failed scans; PGSTAT02 does not export all scan/no-grant/overflow fields.
captured_frames plus dropped_frames is not total camera frames; neither no-grant losses nor sensor exposure events are exported.
PGSIG packet CRC validates transport. FPGA PixelCRC is not an independent image-correctness or calibration oracle.
External input boundary/reset/bit-load attestations cannot be proven from a nonce, scan epoch or UART wall time.
thermal_status: OT1 unresolved; not final thermal signoff
